ideas.pitch: A real-time voice agent assistant built on Moss that instantly detects user interruptions using ultra-fast semantic context retrieval without vector database bottlenecks.
ideas.title: Sub-10ms Voice Interruption Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly leverages the core sponsor technology (Moss) and targets the low-latency voice requirement highlighted in the hackathon prompt, making it immediately relevant to judges looking for zero-latency AI.

ideas.pitch: An offline-capable semantic router powered by Moss that intercepts developer code generation to enforce security policies in under 10ms.
ideas.title: Instant Codebase Compliance Router
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines high-performance engineering with developer tooling, leveraging the sub-10ms retrieval capability of Moss to solve a hard runtime latency problem.

ideas.pitch: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) compatible server backed by Moss that injects relevant patient history into real-time medical transcription agents in under 10ms.
ideas.title: Zero-Lag Clinical Context Injector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates genuinely hard engineering by combining MCP architecture with zero-latency retrieval, addressing a critical need for real-time safety in medical AI.

ideas.pitch: A browser-based agent memory layer utilizing Moss to fetch relevant long-term agent context locally on device without hitting external vector databases.
ideas.title: Edge-Cached Semantic Memory for Agents
ideas.why_it_could_win: Exploits Moss's ability to run anywhere (browser/edge/device) to achieve true zero-latency client-side AI agent execution.

ideas.pitch: A pre-flight evaluation proxy that uses Moss exemplar indexing to catch prompt injections and policy violations in under 10ms before requests hit large language models.
ideas.title: Real-Time Prompt Firewall & Guardrail
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an urgent production AI problem with measurable performance metrics, fitting the hackathon's core challenge of making latency a competitive advantage.
